overview: The City Council addressed a wide range of civic issues, including parking enforcement errors, neighbourhood development and zoning, streetlight LED conversions, and taxicab accessibility regulations. The Council also heard public testimony on state-level Group Insurance Commission health insurance changes and advanced multiple requests for administration updates.

items.title: Park Medford Ticketing Errors and Enforcement
items.summary: Referred concerns regarding misprinted zip codes on parking citations to a February 7 Committee of the Whole meeting, after a motion to immediately suspend parking enforcement failed.

items.title: Edgerly Field of Dreams and Bud Edgerly Monument
items.summary: Received confirmation that the athletic bubble RFP had expired, and approved a motion to have vocational school students build a cement base to relocate the William 'Bud' Edgerly monument onto the field ahead of a spring rededication.

items.title: Development Planning and Zoning Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution to hold community meetings regarding citywide development following resident opposition to a proposed multi-story project at Salem and Court streets, with councilors calling for comprehensive zoning code updates.

items.title: School Class Size Block Chart
items.summary: Approved a request for the superintendent to provide school class-size block charts and school capacity updates annually in June and late autumn.

items.title: Sewer Connection Fee Update
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting an update from the administration and Water and Sewer Commission on any potential implementation of sewer connection fees.

items.title: Chapter 90 Funding Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a four-year itemized breakdown of Chapter 90 roadway infrastructure funding receipts and expenditures.

items.title: Citywide LED Streetlight Conversion
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the citywide conversion of municipal streetlights to energy-efficient LED fixtures.

items.title: Taxicab Licensing and Accessibility Ordinance
items.summary: Passed the taxicab licensing ordinance to its first reading with paratransit plan requirements intact, after a proposed amendment to mandate wheelchair-accessible vehicles for fleets of five or more was withdrawn.

items.title: Petition on Proposed GIC Health Insurance Changes
items.summary: Placed on file a citizen petition addressing proposed state Group Insurance Commission rate increases and plan restructuring, following the recusal of three councilors who subscribe to GIC coverage.

items.title: West Medford Freight Train Frequency
items.summary: Referred resident complaints regarding the vibration, noise, and diesel exhaust of freight trains operating through West Medford to the Department of Transportation and the city solicitor.

items.title: Commendations, Condolences, and Committee Meeting Requests
items.summary: Adopted a 60th birthday resolution for Roberto Vasquez, condolences for the family of Laurie Esnaldi, and agreed to schedule a committee meeting with the developer regarding the Malden Hospital parcel.
